description: Our Lowest Point Since Slavery My Fellow Coloradoans, Our country is at its lowest point since slavery. Our president is an ignorant liar, a man of zero moral or intellectual substance. We are being governed accordingly. [...]
title: Trail Mix 3 – Gaylon Kent For Congress
